description:
Deploy four Maven artifact files to the 'example-repo-local' repository in Artifactory, placing each file at the correct Maven GAV (groupId/artifactId/version) directory path. 

The source files are located on the Desktop:
1. commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar
2. commons-lang3-3.14.0.pom
3. commons-io-2.15.1.jar
4. commons-io-2.15.1.pom

Target Repository: example-repo-local

Required Target Paths:
1. commons-lang3 JAR -> org/apache/commons/commons-lang3/3.14.0/commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar
2. commons-lang3 POM -> org/apache/commons/commons-lang3/3.14.0/commons-lang3-3.14.0.pom
3. commons-io JAR -> commons-io/commons-io/2.15.1/commons-io-2.15.1.jar
4. commons-io POM -> commons-io/commons-io/2.15.1/commons-io-2.15.1.pom

Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 with username 'admin' and password 'password'. Use the 'Deploy' feature in the UI to upload these files to the specified paths.
